I found one regression and one API inconsistency worth fixing before this lands.

```markdown
- calc.js:6-8 removes the zero-division guard from `divide()`. In JavaScript, `a / 0` returns `Infinity`/`-Infinity` rather than throwing, so this changes the function’s behavior and breaks any callers that relied on the previous error for invalid input.
- calc.js:10-12 exports `Multiply` with an uppercase name while the rest of the module uses lowercase verb names. That makes the public API inconsistent and easy to miscall; if this is intended to be a general math helper, `multiply` is the expected export name.

VERDICT: request-changes
```
